newsitem.title: ITALY: Five Ethiopian soccer players renounce asylum.
newsitem.headline: Five Ethiopian soccer players renounce asylum.

text.p: Five of the 16 members of Ethiopia's national soccer squad who sought political asylum in Italy changed their minds on Thursday and tried to return home, airport sources said.

"Five have decided to renounce political asylum," one source said. "They came to the airport to try to take the flight to Addis Ababa with the rest of the squad, but they missed the flight. They plan to leave tomorrow."
Sixteen players went missing when the 23-member team stopped in Rome on the way to Casablanca for an African Nations' Cup match against Morocco.
They turned up 24 hours later at the foreigners office of Rome police headquarters and asked for asylum.
The five players told border police at Rome airport that they wanted to leave on the Ethiopian Airlines flight carrying the seven members of the squad who had not asked for asylum.
"They realised that they had made a mistake", Mekele Beseka, an official of the Ethiopian team, told reporters at the airport.
Lawyer Mario Lana, who helped them with the the asylum request, said he did not know about the five who changed their minds.
